title: Streaming Kth Largest
statement:
Use a size-k min-heap to maintain the kth largest value as numbers arrive. Equal values occupy separate ranks.

Input
n k, then n integers with 1 ≤ k ≤ n.

Output
Print the kth largest after each insertion starting at insertion k.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹.
